_note: Big-Ideas model — the SSOT for the site landing, projected model-first (a sibling of definitions.json and outcomes.json: same 'the site is a projection of a structured model' discipline). The landing IS the book's argument in the book's own order: six Big Ideas, each rendered as one slot — its figure, a concise claim, a light 'expand to learn more', and a 'Read in the book →' link — plus a gateway that fronts the catalogue's By-model view. catalog.py's _landing_big_ideas() iterates this file at build time; nothing on the landing's Big-Ideas argument is hand-authored in HTML. The drift check (check_big_ideas in catalog.py validate) joins on the slug and asserts: (a) every book_home resolves to a real chapter/page on disk (the 'site is a preview, book ⊇ site' rule made mechanical), (b) every figure exists under book/assets/ (palette conformance for every asset is enforced separately + audit-only by the design-token drift lint), (c) every claim is within the word cap, and (d) every slot id resolves on the built landing. Queryable/rendered via `python3 catalog.py build`.
_derivation: The confirmed six-idea → figure mapping ratified in the Big-Ideas reorg design (landing-bigideas-260731, Option 3 'the argument'). Ideas 1 and the old F1-modeling candidate merged: F1 (the model map) is the Modeling Thesis instantiated over this repo, so it becomes the gateway into the By-model catalogue view rather than a competing mid-page slot. The two-schools/midway material is promoted into the set as the stance idea.
_concept_card_fields: Two OPTIONAL per-concept fields the Concept-Card projection (book-models/landing_big_ideas_model.py) reads on top of the nine the landing bands read. `mechanisms`: the hand-declared Concept->mechanism edge — a list of catalogue entry slugs (agent/models-bridge/product) that instantiate or enforce this concept; the owning side of the edge, may be [] for a thin card; every slug must resolve to a real catalogue entry (checked by the model's CC2). `related_ideas`: an optional curated override for the Relationships section — a list of the six concept slugs; [] means the projector falls back to the _order-adjacency seed at render time. The gateway record is NOT a concept and carries neither.

churn.title: Churn is the scaling limit
churn.claim: An agent fleet scales until the work outgrows its context window. Then it churns: it re-derives what it already built and confidently undoes yesterday's fix.
churn.more: A team of people slows under Brooks's Law; an agent fleet collapses when the work exceeds its window. Churn is the symptom; its causes are three not-knowings — what to build, how to realize it, how to change safely — and the theses below divide them: models treat the first two, governance the third.

governance-centric.title: Governance-centric — the enabling substrate
governance-centric.claim: Build the environment first: encode each obligation as a mechanism the environment enforces, so quality is a property of the ground the agents stand on.
governance-centric.more: Velocity-centric hands work around a ring of job titles and leaves quality implicit; oversight-centric parks a human beside each change, and attention does not scale with the fleet. Governance pays attention per class of failure instead: once, when you build the mechanism that retires it.

modeling-thesis.title: Documentation, taken to its limit, is a structured model
modeling-thesis.claim: A context-bounded agent cannot hold the whole system. Give it a structured, drift-checked model to reason through, and the work fits in the window.
modeling-thesis.more: Models used to die because keeping them current was somebody's unpaid job; agents now do that job for cents, re-checking the map against the code on every change. A drifted prose doc lies quietly — a drifted model fails the build.

alignment-thesis.title: Hold intent with a mechanism: prevent first, sense the rest
alignment-thesis.claim: Enforced mechanisms hold work to intent across later changes. Constrain first so the wrong move is unavailable; where prevention falls short, a sensor catches the drift.
alignment-thesis.more: A type the compiler checks, a lint that blocks the commit, a gate that refuses the deploy: each holds a policy decided once against every later change. Costly goals earn both a constraint and a sensor; what neither reaches stays a human job.

convert-failures.title: Convert recurring failures into controls
convert-failures.claim: Velocity surfaces the failures you could not foresee. Convert each recurring one into a mechanism, pushed as far toward hard enforcement as it will go.
convert-failures.more: Mechanisms sit on a spectrum from soft to hard: a convention or a brief aims the agent but cannot block it; a lint or a gate holds the line whether the agent cooperates or not. The second time a soft rule fails, move it right — the documented rule becomes a lint the agent cannot talk past.

seat-moves.title: The lifecycle stays, but now agents sit in the developer's seat
seat-moves.claim: SDLC becomes SELC: one seat reassigned, the lifecycle otherwise intact. The fleet writes the code; the engineer keeps the seats that were always the engineering.
seat-moves.more: The engineer flanks the fleet: models carry intent in on one side, judgment meets the output on the other. The seats the human keeps — requirements, specification, design, validation — were always the consequential ones; now they are the job.

gateway.kicker: Kept honest — the gateway to the catalogue
gateway.title: The models are the interface; the map is kept equal to the territory
gateway.claim: Two spines of models over one method trunk govern this very repo; the catalogue's mechanisms hold them true.
gateway.more: The models are the interface a context-bounded fleet operates a context-exceeding codebase through. Browse the mechanisms by the model they govern.
